name: CLI Entry Point
description: Command-line interface via apprentice.cli:main. A thin shell with three responsibilities: (1) parse arguments via argparse with subcommands (run, status, report) and global flags (--config, --json, --verbose), (2) load config and construct Apprentice instance via dependency injection, (3) format and print results. Synchronous entry point that calls asyncio.run() exactly once. Handles Ctrl+C gracefully (exit 130), SIGPIPE on Unix, and fails fast on config errors. Structured JSON logging to stderr. File kept under 300 lines by extracting result models to cli_models.py and formatters to cli_formatters.py.

functions.name: main
functions.description: Synchronous CLI entry point. Parses argv, loads config, constructs Apprentice, dispatches to the appropriate subcommand, formats output, and returns an exit code. Calls asyncio.run() exactly once to execute async Apprentice methods. Configures structured JSON logging to stderr before any other work. Handles SIGPIPE on Unix to prevent BrokenPipeError tracebacks.

inputs.name: argv
inputs.description: Command-line arguments (excluding program name). If None, defaults to sys.argv[1:]. Accepts None for testability.

preconditions: asyncio event loop is not already running (no nested asyncio.run())
Standard file descriptors (stdin, stdout, stderr) are available

All output written to stdout (results) or stderr (errors, logs) before return
No background tasks or threads are left running after return

functions.name: parse_args
functions.description: Parses raw command-line arguments into a structured ParsedArgs model using argparse. Defines the top-level parser with global flags (--config, --json, --verbose) and three subcommands (run, status, report) via add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True). Pure function with no side effects except argparse's SystemExit on invalid input.

functions.name: load_config
functions.description: Loads and validates the Apprentice YAML configuration file from the given path. Reads the file, parses YAML, and validates against the ApprenticeConfig pydantic model with strict mode. Fails immediately with a clear error message on missing file or validation failure — never silently defaults.

functions.name: resolve_input
functions.description: Resolves the raw --input argument into a parsed dictionary. If the input string starts with '@', treats the remainder as a file path and reads JSON from that file. Otherwise, parses the string directly as JSON. Validates that the result is a JSON object (dict), not an array or scalar.

functions.name: format_output
functions.description: Serializes a subcommand result (RunResult, StatusResult, or ReportResult) into a string suitable for terminal output. In JSON mode, produces compact JSON via pydantic's model_dump_json(). In human mode, produces a formatted table or structured text output with aligned columns and section headers.

inputs.description: The result model from any subcommand execution.

inputs.name: json_mode
inputs.description: If true, output machine-readable JSON. If false, output human-readable formatted text.

error_cases.name: serialization_error
error_cases.condition: The result model contains values that cannot be serialized (should not happen with well-typed models)

preconditions: result is a valid RunResult, StatusResult, or ReportResult instance
postconditions: Returned string is non-empty
In JSON mode, returned string is valid JSON parseable by json.loads()
In human mode, returned string contains no raw JSON — values are formatted for readability
Returned string does not include a trailing newline (caller adds newline when printing)

functions.name: configure_logging
functions.description: Configures the Python logging subsystem for structured JSON output to stderr. Sets the root logger level based on the verbose flag (0=WARNING, 1=INFO, 2=DEBUG). Installs a JSON formatter that produces one JSON object per log line with fields: timestamp, level, logger, message, and any extra context. Must be called once at the start of main() before any other work.
preconditions: stderr file descriptor is available and writable
This function has not been called previously in this process (idempotent in effect but should only be called once)
postconditions: Root logger level is set to WARNING (verbose=0), INFO (verbose=1), or DEBUG (verbose=2)
All log output is directed to stderr, never stdout
Log format is structured JSON with one object per line
Each log line contains: timestamp (ISO 8601), level, logger name, message

structured_side_effects.description: Configures root logger level, handler, and formatter. Replaces any existing handlers on the root logger.

invariants: asyncio.run() is called exactly once per main() invocation, never nested
All output to stdout; all errors and logs to stderr
No global mutable state — all state flows through function parameters or local variables
Exit codes are deterministic: 0 for success, 1 for application/config error, 2 for usage error, 130 for keyboard interrupt
Config validation errors always fail at startup, never silently default
The CLI module never catches BaseException — only Exception subclasses and KeyboardInterrupt
Structured JSON logging is configured before any other work in main()
File cli.py is under 300 lines; result models live in cli_models.py, formatters in cli_formatters.py
All pydantic models use strict mode for serialization correctness
